![](images/5225eeb605ec3b2c8603c69df70058126e5d8c5f7032f92610e6d53672c9276e.jpg)

### Removal
`chery_a13_en_ee6394d8` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:steering | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Turn off all electrical equipment and the ignition switch.

2. Disconnect the negative battery cable.

3. Remove the engine trim cover.

4. Raise vehicle to a proper position.

5. Remove the power steering pump belt (See page 29-15).

6. Remove the V-ribbed belt.

a. Rotate V-ribbed drive belt tensioner assembly in direction of arrow as shown in illustration with a wrench (2), while aligning lock hole of tensioner with lock hole of bracket, and insert lock pin (1) to lock tensioner.

b. Remove the V-ribbed belt (3).

![](images/567fa90b765f7d537395d3ea128b3c6c988d36bab07f2acfce8c188c554dc772.jpg)

### Inspection
`chery_a13_en_6647cd31` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Check the V-ribbed belt.

Visually check V-ribbed belt for excessive wear, frayed cords, etc. If any defect has been found, replace V-ribbed belt.

![](images/b08390942e5714942ad30fa7b936349b6e580b0012cca22656247e201de9d076.jpg)

### HINT:
`chery_a13_en_eb371de0` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Cracks on the rib side of a V-ribbed belt are considered acceptable. If drive belt has chunks missing from its ribs, it should be replaced.
After installing V-ribbed belt, check that it fits properly in ribbed grooves. Check that belt has not slipped out of grooves on bottom of the crankshaft pulley by hands.

### Removal
`chery_a13_en_dc132ea7` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Turn off all electrical equipment and the ignition switch.

2. Disconnect the negative battery cable.

3. Loosen the V-ribbed belt.

a. Rotate V-ribbed drive belt tensioner assembly in direction of arrow as shown in illustration with a wrench (2), while aligning lock hole of tensioner with lock hole of bracket, and insert lock pin (1) to lock tensioner.

b. Move away the V-ribbed belt (3).

![](images/6027e5a92e4663dba408a073e566462d93b0c8d89a4e59a0239aa0318b3ed79a.jpg)

4. Remove the idler pulley assembly.

a. Remove the idler pulley fixing bolt (arrow). (Tightening torque: 45 ± 5 N·m)

![](images/8e775ec08820575d64d531797de0ffd22639cb775bbc905d4e17f30f1825ed8f.jpg)

b. Remove the idler pulley assembly.

### Inspection
`chery_a13_en_552f0f8e` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Rotate idler pulley by hands and check if rotation is smooth and if abnormal noise occurs.
2. Wiggle idler pulley in axial and radial directions to check bearing for looseness.
3. Check if there is damage on idler pulley assembly operating surface.

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_80ace535` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

After installation, turn crankshaft with a wrench to run V-ribbed belt several circles, and check if crankshaft turns smoothly and belt runs well. If it does not turn smoothly, reinstall V-ribbed belt. Make sure to correctly install V-ribbed belt, and it does not interfere with other components.

### Removal
`chery_a13_en_dc132ea7` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Turn off all electrical equipment and the ignition switch.

2. Disconnect the negative battery cable.

3. Loosen the V-ribbed belt.

a. Rotate V-ribbed drive belt tensioner assembly in direction of arrow as shown in illustration with a wrench (2), while aligning lock hole of tensioner with lock hole of bracket, and insert lock pin (1) to lock tensioner.
b. Move away the V-ribbed belt (3).

![](images/67a81f8e257f8bb5a1c1b40dacd9dda7a60284145875161469641edf01213fce.jpg)

4. Remove the tensioner assembly.

a. Remove 3 tensioner inner torx round fixing bolts (arrow). (Tightening torque for inner torx round bolts: 25 ± 3 N·m)

![](images/76b1ab76a98f5bc6db643bbb95e32e908a356e0c6856418f81f6393a75f32efb.jpg)

b. Remove the tensioner assembly.

### Inspection
`chery_a13_en_6cf65d4a` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Rotate tensioner assembly by hands and check if rotation is smooth and if abnormal noise occurs.
2. Wiggle tensioner assembly in axial and radial direction to check bearing for looseness.
3. Check if there is damage on tensioner assembly operating surface.

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_80ace535` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

After installation, turn crankshaft with a wrench to run V-ribbed belt several circles, and check if crankshaft turns smoothly and belt runs well. If it does not turn smoothly, reinstall V-ribbed belt. Make sure to correctly install V-ribbed belt, and it does not interfere with other components.

### Engine Timing Belt
`chery_a13_en_aa136531` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Description

![](images/9884c6b4e0e8e9935157f7c671af9bace5ffea9af1ecdc2791d7dfd155fd50bd.jpg)

RA13T070060

![](images/e798bc47dfcf0bc747103896f1bddcb4bef7c01c46b4e3f6c84fa73157345516.jpg)

### Removal
`chery_a13_en_d475bceb` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Turn off all electrical equipment and the ignition switch.

2. Disconnect the negative battery cable.

3. Remove the drive belt (See page 07-19).

4. Remove the timing belt cover.

a. Loosen and remove 3 fixing bolts (arrow), and remove timing belt upper cover (1). (Tightening torque: 8 ＋ 3 N·m)

b. Rotate crankshaft pulley to align mark (arrow) on camshaft timing pulley (1) and mark (2) on cylinder head as shown in illustration. Also, align mark (3) on crankshaft pulley and the fifth protrusion mark (4) on timing belt lower cover.

![](images/b6a674653332ad7ee0fb72366e1b91d3269ae1a04762d8fe70c52f4e4e32dc46.jpg)

c. Loosen and remove fixing bolt (arrow), and remove crankshaft pulley. (Tightening torque: 105 115 N·m)

HINT:

Shift transmission into 5th gear when loosening crankshaft pulley fixing bolt to engage crankshaft and propeller shaft. Another technician depresses brake pedal, which can lock the crankshaft by mechanical gear train.

d. Loosen and remove 3 fixing bolts (arrow), and remove timing belt lower cover (1). (Tightening torque: 8 ＋ 3 N·m)

![](images/8aa74af8497b94fda16a4686904ac334bdd7a61f03af8c851f10b4ac34a9d0b0.jpg)

5. Remove the timing belt.

a. Remove fixing bolt (1) and idler pulley assembly. (Tightening torque: 25 ± 3 N·m)
b. Remove 2 fixing bolts (arrow) and timing belt tensioner. (Tightening torque: 20 ＋ 5 N·m)

![](images/c8e5aeda12c0a32a04d59fb5382c05b7cd69da227df1ddb05f85f438672a5c01.jpg)

c. Remove the timing belt (2).

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_c93dd154` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Check timing belt carefully before installation, replace it to avoid any of following conditions.

If timing belt has following conditions, replace it.

a. Cracks on back of belt: as shown in illustration (1). b. Cracks at cord fabric layer and bottom of belt: as shown in illustrations (2), (3) and (5). c. Belt worn: as shown in illustration (6). d. Belt teeth missing and damaged: as shown in illustrations (4) and (6).

![](images/1f870672d485a8b216629e707f8a4d004651e6612df0c28886edb9c1bed74ee7.jpg)

2. Check the timing belt tensioner.

a. Rotate timing belt tensioner by hands and check if rotation is smooth and if abnormal noise occurs. b. Wiggle timing belt tensioner in axial and radial direction to check if there is slackness. c. Check if there is damage on timing belt tensioner surface.

![](images/c6c20c5e30cb6ef76c2e34c9a25d0450be24cf6484b06d46a962677ee8fbd98f.jpg)

### Installation
`chery_a13_en_75cfaafd` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Install timing belt and be sure that arrow mark on camshaft phaser is aligned with upper mark on cylinder (upper left local figure). Also, protrusion mark on crankshaft timing pulley is aligned with mark on oil pump house (lower right local figure). 2. Check if timing belt is correctly installed to camshaft phaser (1), timing belt tensioner (5), water pump pulley (4) and crankshaft timing pulley (3).

![](images/927f3398493750afab0eadcbf053b1089664e8eefd883eda6d8f19f033416960.jpg)

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_0e6ce818` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Crankshaft and camshaft must be locked when installing timing belt.

3. Rotate crankshaft for one turn to check if timing mark is offset. Remove and reinstall belt if necessary. Other procedures are in the reverse order of removal.

### Removal
`chery_a13_en_19bcadaf` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Turn off all electrical equipment and the ignition switch.
2. Disconnect the negative battery cable.
3. Remove the drive belt (See page 07-19).
4. Remove the engine timing belt (See page 07-23).
5. Remove crankshaft timing pulley (1) and crankshaft
timing pulley washer (2) from crankshaft.

![](images/03e510f4f51e8049cab986f100c12f3542cdca69c6d81a73d36ef4a4134aabf1.jpg)

6. Remove the crankshaft front oil seal. a. Using a flat tip screwdriver with tip wrapped with tape, pry out crankshaft front oil seal (arrow).

![](images/c228208dd1c7fe8d5467c8c34dafd8adc0bf8e84a8edc63232620ccd0ef3cb87.jpg)

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_d279b75b` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Be careful not to damage oil seal retainer and surface of crankshaft, when removing crankshaft front oil seal.

### Installation
`chery_a13_en_518fedd2` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Install crankshaft front oil seal guide tool (3) to crankshaft (4). 2. Install new oil seal (2) to crankshaft front oil seal guide tool, then install new oil seal fully into oil seal retainer with crankshaft front oil seal installer (1).

![](images/bfa9b1457b3049a178da94d8064e674ad99f475b61ccb99f2fcdc37d4fe4ee54.jpg)

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_11e009c1` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Apply a coat of engine oil to the crankshaft front oil seal guide tool before installing a new oil seal. Remove dirt on oil seal retainer and apply a coat of engine oil to oil seal retainer and oil seal lip before installation.
Be sure to prevent the lip of crankshaft front oil seal from being scratched during installation. If it is damaged, replace immediately.

Other installation procedures are in the reverse order of removal.

### Removal
`chery_a13_en_19bcadaf` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Turn off all electrical equipment and the ignition switch.
2. Disconnect the negative battery cable.
3. Remove the drive belt (See page 07-19).
4. Remove the engine timing belt (See page 07-23).
5. Remove the cylinder head cover (See page 07-31).
6. Remove the rocker arm shaft (See page 07-34).
7. Remove the camshaft timing pulley. a. Hold hexagon position on camshaft with a tool, and remove camshaft phaser fixing cover with a wrench in direction of arrow as shown in illustration. (Tightening torque: 30 ± 5 N·m)

![](images/f55598e61e481b2a5d6c8daa8324a1352ad2156558222ffe68ef754c87c927a5.jpg)

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_2226dcfe` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Check if cover seal ring is in good condition before installation.

b. Hold camshaft with a tool, and remove camshaft phaser fixing bolt with a wrench in direction of arrow as shown in illustration. (Tightening torque: 120 ± 6 N·m)

![](images/ff6855a7f72dc6b6134efcb24cea119bfc9bc025f0d3c425c39ddeec305a433d.jpg)

c. Remove the phaser.

8. Remove the camshaft oil seal. a. Using a flat tip screwdriver with tip wrapped with tape, pry out camshaft oil seal (arrow).

![](images/224ae2c598d0dae6d8cba2c73b47b81b0357b126ac785dfc38759be7b19b9e1a.jpg)

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_e1f20119` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Be careful not to damage oil seal retainer and surface of camshaft, when removing camshaft oil seal.

### Installation
`chery_a13_en_3c20d1e8` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Using a special tool (camshaft oil seal installer) (1), install new oil seal (2) to camshaft (3).

![](images/5db49c02c4f0ebeadfb8ba3b01d995472da9d5a8ee02b30fb1144115ddb863b6.jpg)

Remove dirt on oil seal retainer and apply a coat of engine oil to oil seal retainer and oil seal lip before installation.
Be sure to prevent the lip of crankshaft front oil seal from being scratched during installation. If it is damaged, replace immediately.
2. Dowel pin on back side of phaser and positioning hole of camshaft should be fitted in place when installing phaser.
Other installation procedures are in the reverse order of removal.

### Removal
`chery_a13_en_b84c8efe` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Turn off all electrical equipment and the ignition switch.
2. Disconnect the negative battery cable.
3. Remove the engine trim cover.
4. Blow dirt and debris away from upper surface of cylinder head cover with compressed air.
5. Remove intake hose and crankcase ventilation hose assembly.

a. Loosen elastic clamp (arrow) and disconnect crankcase ventilation hose from cylinder head cover.

![](images/bbd5d17bd46f260825a869ea3f91f0515db382ebd200b3f0c3627dc8ab2f96b5.jpg)

b. Remove the crankcase ventilation hose assembly.

6. Remove the ignition coil (See page 14-8).

7. Remove the PCV valve (See page 09-11).

8. Remove the camshaft position sensor. a. Disconnect camshaft position sensor connector (1). b. Remove the camshaft position sensor fixing bolt (arrow). (Tightening torque: 10 ± 2 N·m)

![](images/ca12199d6d3ea6b7719be909368c966d2f8a9df2dcfb81be284acc04ab9fc7ac.jpg)

c. Remove camshaft position sensor from cylinder head cover.

9. Remove the cylinder head cover.

a. Remove 2 fixing bolts (arrow), and disconnect 2 ground wires from cylinder head cover. (Tightening torque: 7 ± 1 N·m)

![](images/8d084a36504470c7738c2fcd4d93bf580028b11c14e585f4a543cbe041de2889.jpg)

b. Remove fixing bolt (1) and move away wire harness bracket. (Tightening torque: 7 ± 1 N·m)

c. Remove 4 fixing bolts (arrow) from discharge pipe assembly, and remove 2 front bracket assembly (1). (Tightening torque: 9 ± N·m)

![](images/95d194308098f0c2988c46e498dfb19d9ccc74a21b05d2fcfb6fed79e5218c0a.jpg)

d. Loosen 2 fixing bolts (arrow) from timing belt upper cover, and remove oil dipstick. (Tightening torque: 8 ＋ 3 N·m)

![](images/0c3cd89a6d790b3942f7efc10b47ca6722a4e0947cad4bf1e1246371ee52639d.jpg)

e. Remove cylinder head cover fixing bolts in order shown in illustration. (Tightening torque: 1st step: pre-tighten to 5 ± N·m, 2nd step: tighten to 10 ± N·m)

![](images/41b724693f5670d585b1f8e0b11a8cda130596627a4cc5d95f76c32acb0b4ec7.jpg)

f. Remove cylinder head cover from cylinder head.

CAUTION

Remove oil and seal gum on cylinder head cover with a special tool.

10.Remove the cylinder head cover gasket.

### Installation
`chery_a13_en_d5da4fe5` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Replace cylinder head cover gasket and spark plug guide gasket.

2. Install cylinder head cover gasket into groove on cylinder head cover, and apply seal gum to cylinder head cover gasket in elliptical areas as shown in illustration.

![](images/c9503870b44f3ed0fde319f1f921c3507becac67bbf3f69b22c640bebef460e0.jpg)

3. Hold cylinder head cover with your hands, pass spark plug guide through gasket and press it forcefully to match head cover with bolt hole of cylinder head, and install head cover to cylinder head after aligning. Carefully handle during assembly to avoid gasket falling out from head cover, and it should be assemblied in place once to prevent adhesive offset.

4. Install head cover bolts to cylinder head cover in order shown in illustration, and pay attention to following procedures:

a. Install bolts and tighten them in place by hands. b. Pre-tighten them with a force of 5 ＋ 1 N·m in sequence; c. Tighten them with a force of 10 ＋ 1 N·m in sequence;

![](images/fae40c4c137127d606362f805e4cbb0947e887ff7f5605390a2b4a255abc4015.jpg)

### Camshaft & Rocker Arm
`chery_a13_en_47c22d35` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Description

![](images/8cc7a37611e16c302d21fee533c36dec666fe224beff86df8f1cd90e371b1f10.jpg)

![](images/3638451f2a2e9b65adf6f25571ddc05a9758c625019c22a0bf37e5951671e3e7.jpg)

### Removal
`chery_a13_en_f2787437` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Turn off all electrical equipment and the ignition switch.
2. Disconnect the negative battery cable.
3. Remove the engine trim cover.
4. Remove the ignition coil (See page 14-8).
5. Remove the accessory drive belt (See page 07-19).
6. Remove the engine timing belt (See page 07-23).
7. Remove the cylinder head cover assembly (See page 07-31).
8. Remove the camshaft oil seal (See page 07-29).
9. Remove rocker arm shaft and camshaft. a. Remove 10 fixing bolts in order shown in illustration, remove rocker arm shaft with rocker arm assembly and store them carefully.

![](images/33a2c3b8706808a6026e5ea15d2d91849c4766c39f159550286bdd1131b159a0.jpg)

b. Remove 2 fixing bolts (arrow), and remove camshaft bearing caps (1) to (5) in order, then remove camshaft (6). (Tightening torque: 9.5 ± 1 N·m)

![](images/2677978b36c0ad408f8a1729f2cea32b3736c693959eefbcfd58f985a5dc73bf.jpg)

c. Place removed parts on workbench in order.

![](images/c72ca15d1026748354d715ba37eeceef3f4a98395b81308a06abe1befedbb3d2.jpg)

d. Place intake and exhaust rocker arms and rocker shafts in an assembly relationship on workbench after disassembling.

### Inspection
`chery_a13_en_db649d38` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Check the rocker arm shaft a. Check the rocker arm shaft diameter. Measure intake/exhaust rocker arm shaft diameter with an outer diameter micrometer.

![](images/76102ec6f8399d576d2446021ab8416838ceee4a175895fa39799a511b72894e.jpg)

If intake/exhaust rocker arm shaft diameter is not within specified range, replace intake/exhaust rocker arm shaft.

![](images/1c9601a8cc5a85289db260cd59f39e764e7c552900f4729423c85b691e1b1d07.jpg)

2. Check the valve rocker arm assembly.

a. Check rocker arm retainer for damage and rocker arm lifter head for damage or falling off. If there is damage or if it has fallen out, replace valve rocker arm assembly.
b. Check if roller rotates freely. If it cannot rotate freely or it is too loose, replace valve rocker arm assembly.
c. Check the valve rocker arm hole. If it is damaged or too tight, replace valve rocker arm assembly.

![](images/aaba6ae7500b230c248aebdc7a3bee1b942b3bded303cda75fc15c205b5dffa7.jpg)

Chery Automobile Co., Ltd.

d. Check the rocker arm shaft bore diameter of intake rocker arm assembly.

Measure rocker arm shaft bore diameter of intake left/ right rocker arm assembly with an inner diameter micrometer.

![](images/113fa59007ca659744aa044880b284a63b4939553ebabdbe638d758864cd0865.jpg)

If rocker arm shaft bore diameter of intake left/right rocker arm assembly is not within specified range, replace intake left/right rocker arm assembly.

![](images/1d9483bf17c5a6671c09bdfe20ecee8edd072313fdcb7cc7e6ad8c2a2fb8e68c.jpg)

e. Check the rocker arm shaft bore diameter of exhaust rocker arm assembly.

Measure rocker arm shaft bore diameter of exhaust rocker arm assembly with an inner diameter micrometer.

![](images/374825991a0cc3c29194ce6128c189b54687fcb025eadc9a25217fed845e02dd.jpg)

If rocker arm shaft bore diameter of exhaust rocker arm assembly is not within specified range, replace exhaust rocker arm assembly.

3. Check the camshaft.

![](images/5474ad8d4563d6c37699073c7dd465168724cf6e29d934c959bb52d603f97e95.jpg)

a. Check the appearance.

Check if there are scratches on camshaft bearings and cam surfaces. If there are scratches, repair or replace camshaft.
Check if there are leaking holes and cracks in camshaft bearing caps. If there are leaking holes or cracks, replace camshaft.

b. Check the camshaft journal diameter.

Measure camshaft journal diameter with an outer diameter micrometer.

![](images/c2898bc0b20263b27bd7d9d1005082aa3955bae275725f8372e5737b12f92f4d.jpg)

If camshaft journal diameter is not within specified range, replace the camshaft.

![](images/3ededb08723797412cd2ff7461b56444cec68e182124e7b1a852427e726d4014.jpg)

c. Check the cam lift.

Measure cam lift with an outer diameter micrometer as shown in illustration.

Cam Lift Height: Measurement A Measurement B

![](images/3deea6121736a7eba8438d3dab06719af422b10799f8bfb039c5f21939543506.jpg)

If camshaft cam lift is not within specified range, replace the camshaft.

![](images/5ca31b552ce4786a1e38872d0734d9af0f7c1245e91fa6d82f1dba743029433e.jpg)

### Inspection
`chery_a13_en_ab9d1707` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

d. Check the camshaft axial clearance.

Reinstall the camshaft.
Remove rocker arm and reinstall rocker arm shaft, install rocker arm shaft bolt and tighten it in 2 steps. 1st step: tighten to 15 ± 2 N·m, and 2nd step: tighten to 30 ± 3 N·m. After pre-tightening rocker arm shaft bolts, tighten bolts on both sides of 1st bearing cap to 9.5 ± 1 N·m.
Keep plunger of dial indicator in contact with front end of camshaft. Push camshaft forward and backward gently (do not rotate camshaft) and read value from dial indicator.

![](images/33c5115b4b0a819998f59b78cb50b975c33a2db07e92c66db4de6bf3a9ad7648.jpg)

![](images/cacba4f4705ff7012db11c46f2f973151af2c631c67da800dcf54d2955de8fc3.jpg)

If camshaft axial clearance is not within specified range, replace the camshaft.

### Installation
`chery_a13_en_0d42c988` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Clean intake and exhaust rocker arm shafts, camshaft and camshaft bearing caps. 2. Check for any residue or impurities on rocker shaft hole.

![](images/234f5322f93e4d3ff3f907f297b8aff339ec49a0544c6f945da19d5a6372ea82.jpg)

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_b20cff55` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Distinguish intake and exhaust rocker arm shafts. There are 4 grooves on intake rocker arm shaft (1) (to avoid spark plug pipe), but there is no groove on exhaust rocker arm shaft (2). Check that there should be no burr, overlap or chips on each oil hole of rocker arm shaft and chamfers on both ends of oil guide when assembling. Rocker arm shaft outer surface should be clean without residue or foreign matter.

3. Check if intake and exhaust rocker arm heads and intake rocker arm bushing are normal. Apply engine oil to rocker shaft, and install rocker arm to rocker arm shaft.

![](images/c57573d7167d3b52c869eedbe4870d8d08019b95952a0601895a87ae4a210157.jpg)

4. Apply engine oil to contact surface of camshaft (1), and install camshaft.

![](images/71290308be915692132c2fe2773569d2b189e662a6848ef8cef4555e7de41d0f.jpg)

5. Clean the camshaft bearing cap. Apply seal gum into sealing area (arrow) of 1st camshaft bearing cap as shown in the illustration.

![](images/c1c85fca87bd907d083739df756d53e7b8e562ab802d70ef2fb908e4326e2a5d.jpg)

6. Apply engine oil to cam and camshaft journal, and install camshaft bearing caps (1) to (5) in order.

![](images/6ae14f00843ed4bf6c2351e57737656bfc4c9d50e00f66959947d697fd371930.jpg)

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_5c00ce80` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Dowel pin on camshaft bearing cap should match with clearance of cylinder head. When installing camshaft bearing cap, place your hand to correct position and tap it in place with a rubber hammer. There is resistance when rotating camshaft (6) by hands.

7. Install intake rocker arm shaft assembly (big chamfer end should face 1st camshaft bearing cap, without being reversed.), adjust rocker arm to place it onto bearing seat bracket.

8. Install exhaust rocker arm shaft assembly (big chamfer end should face 1st camshaft bearing cap, without being reversed.), adjust rocker arm without rotating camshaft, and make sure that all exhaust rocker arms are not interfere with bearing race and intake rocker arm.

9. Install the rocker arm shaft bolts. Tighten rocker arm shaft fixing bolts in sequence from (1) to (10) shown in illustration. (Tightening torque: 1st step: tighten to 15 ± 2 N·m, 2nd step: tighten to 30 ± 3 N·m)
10.After pre-tightening rocker arm shaft bolts, tighten bolts (arrow) on both sides of 1st bearing cap. (Tightening torque: 9.5 ± 1 N·m)

![](images/7c2e06a9ac3f81f7b0d768f36cb897328c03dc1c159f949297638afc4c545377.jpg)

11.After tightening rocker arm shaft bolts, apply a proper amount of engine oil to roller of rocker, and make sure that there is a proper amount of engine oil on contact surface between roller and camshaft.

### Description
`chery_a13_en_3cb8e87b` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

RA13T070370

### 07 Removal
`chery_a13_en_866eb7ec` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Release the fuel system pressure (See page 08-10).
2. Turn off all electrical equipment and the ignition switch.
3. Disconnect the negative battery cable.
4. Drain the coolant (See page 12-12).
5. Remove the ignition coil (See page 14-8).
6. Remove the spark plugs (See page 14-10).
7. Remove the thermostat seat (See page 12-20).
8. Remove the EGR valve (See page 09-12).
9. Remove the fuel rail injector assembly (See page 08-22).
10.Remove the electronic throttle assembly (See page 10-11).
11.Remove the intake manifold assembly (See page 10-15).
12.Remove the exhaust manifold assembly (See page 11-7).
13.Remove the alternator and alternator bracket (See page 16-10).
14.Remove the engine timing belt (See page 07-23).
15.Remove the camshaft oil seal (See page 07-29).
16.Remove the DVVT.
a. Remove the DVVT connector (1).
b. Remove the fixing bolt (arrow).
(Tightening torque: 8 + 2 N·m)

![](images/0b396ef394a09c01dd4b6f0bc2c07e98ea948d2f6c43d2f2b3f542744648f73c.jpg)

17.Remove the camshaft and rocker arm shaft (See page 07-34).

18.Remove cylinder head fixing bolts (1) to (10) in order shown in illustration.

![](images/8b76649631d7b9e380aed55e3aecff66e018a6819fef5cd344dc732fc4aa31c6.jpg)

CAUTION

Failure to follow the sequence to remove cylinder head bolts will cause cylinder head deformation.

19.Remove the cylinder head and cylinder head gasket.

CAUTION

Replace washer with a new one.

### Disassembly
`chery_a13_en_177e0220` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Remove 4 fixing bolts (arrow), and remove EGR cover plate. (Tightening torque: 10 ± 1 N.m)

2. Using a specia tool (valve spring compressor), compress valve spring and remove valve cotter with a flexional magnetic rod.

![](images/b149b44360e037e841bdc8cd7f8165b29344201f4659fd2250afc4d32901223e.jpg)

3. Remove the valve spring upper seat (1), valve spring (2) and valve (3) from cylinder head.

![](images/99270be3af4f87ab050b6f0d9459e3f6b8d91392c822194d2c216ddb4254a0b4.jpg)

4. Using a valve oil seal remover (1), remove the valve oil seal (2).

5. Using a flexional magnetic rod, remove the valve spring lower seat.

### Inspection
`chery_a13_en_218ace88` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Check the cylinder head.

a. Check the appearance.

Check if there are scratches on camshaft bearing journals.
Remove carbon deposits and varnish inside valve guides with valve guide cleaner.
Make sure valve cotters can move and rotate freely.

b. Check the cylinder head flatness.

Using a precision straightedge and feeler gauge, check cylinder head flatness. Cylinder head flatness must be within 0.04 mm.

![](images/9da5e65fba1b20bd0c84cafdc18abe8609468661753feaa551c315272042d5f8.jpg)

If cylinder head flatness is not within specified range, modify or replace it.

![](images/559faf30f18e34a068cacb489d7716f9620356fbcc35356691b9fab08e664330.jpg)

c. Check the cylinder head height.

Using a precision straightedge, measure cylinder head height.

![](images/b126a2a1bf20117ff2a157a4b6de9b06d9dc6fc9d247ee655e14a9b2d33f3c50.jpg)

If cylinder head height is not within specified range, replace the cylinder head.

![](images/0d130c5162c309189283b219e67706e2103a2cb2578be3307e0ddb69f2fbe0e6.jpg)

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_1eecbef6` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

During replacement, cylinder head should be fully equipped with valves, oil seals, springs, seats, cotters, hydraulic lifters and crankshaft.

2. Check the valve spring.

Using a vernier caliper, measure free height of valve spring and length of valve spring under pre-pressure of 249 271 N.

![](images/717461a7a91e69d1178a7a5502d14f3c6ba026e39ff9996ed0da4e56161c31ef.jpg)

If valve spring length is not within specified range, replace the valve spring.

3. Check the valve.

![](images/3a66260070e89874c7d75b56b8d885ce518e3629041b8e3cd1cd45ad6d9ef6f4.jpg)

a. Clean the valve.

Using a scraper, remove carbon deposited on valve head. Using a wire brush, clean the valve thoroughly.

![](images/8622103ca4cc81a2184ccdb27ea1769684bf06610e52eae3a6b342ac0857fc42.jpg)

b. Check the valve height. Using a vernier caliper, measure the valve height.

![](images/ff16a891c6e721e12bc6632bb6a8254ae0fc3efd32ef7f84ec89a48e35734d0c.jpg)

If height is less than specified value, replace the valve. c. Check the valve head. Measure valve head with a vernier caliper.

![](images/56c01404b9c2c3e2c9aa72e3fe8eed358ce850bfe861e317fe80676dae187505.jpg)

If not within specified range, replace the valve. d. Check the valve stem diameter. Using a micrometer, measure the valve stem diameter.

![](images/5af3dab25843f55b5987373ca292df72916dc9b9b8727db45b28d2b259e35fdc.jpg)

If valve stem diameter is not within specified range, check clearance between valve stem and valve guide.

e. Check clearance between valve stem and valve guide.

Install a dial indicator (1) to bracket (2). Install intake valve or exhaust valve to guide to be inspected.
Check clearance between valve stem and valve guide with the dial indicator. Pull valve guide approximately 10 mm from valve to be inspected, and slightly wiggle valve to measure clearance between valve and valve guide.

![](images/c1fb8f9ea695e07114c65efd651a355ca325a43726e01075552a3a8f3177ed8d.jpg)

![](images/cee5f9cd95660b907ad96c9683c07871f4c45beadfed943fccae5cca6ebad492.jpg)

![](images/b18d207c933d3ad0c2b40687e2d83d0c139443dc5a3878c7da63ec1a6ddfb59b.jpg)

![](images/6f6d7b1a021faaf991ca09028a65d1b97033d202587cd86280e04528a6670313.jpg)

![](images/12635e1a391cefd14cde7fe4e9cbdc471e16146aa1dcf06cbd17217614986400.jpg)

If clearance is not within specified range, replace valve or valve guide.

### HINT:
`chery_a13_en_0364c6e7` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Clean all components to be assembled thoroughly before assembly.

1. Install valve (1) into cylinder head.

### HINT:
`chery_a13_en_fdc5e82f` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Distinguish intake valves and exhaust valves during installation.
Apply a light coat of engine oil to valve stem end, when assembling valve.

2. Install new valve spring lower seat (2) if necessary.

3. Install the valve oil seal.

HINT:

Apply a light coat of engine oil to installation surface of valve oil seal end, when assembling valve oil seal.

a. Install valve oil seal guide (3) to valve stem. b. Install valve oil seal (4) to valve oil seal guide sleeve. c. Tap valve oil seal installer lightly with a rubber hammer to install valve oil seal in place.

![](images/eaa5447185fa457fd0d282c9612edf1dcad1df9b28eb2b72de30c62c13a401d6.jpg)

4. Install valve cotter (1) to valve cotter installer (2).

5. Install valve spring (1) and valve spring upper seat (2). 6. Using a valve spring compressor, compress valve spring and install valve cotter (3) in place.

![](images/477526a07d374f632dd979c96caa708b6b395c18e4a11d725336acdc2bffea2d.jpg)

7. Tap valve cotter lightly with a rubber hammer to make sure cotter is installed in place after assembly.

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_cbc1e252` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Remove residual seal gum and oil on cylinder head and cylinder block.
Replace O-ring and cylinder head gasket.
Check that cylinder head gasket is neat and clean without any chips and scratches. The side stamped with part number of cylinder head gasket should face upward.
Install cylinder head gasket to flat surface of cylinder block with a dowel pin.
Clean joint surfaces between cylinder head and combustion chamber, together with flat surface of cylinder block top and thread hole.
During installation, piston should not be located at the top dead center, in order to prevent it from being impacted by opening valve, when installing the rocker arm.
Install the cylinder head bolt washer with chamfering surface facing upward and flat side facing cylinder head.

1. Make sure to tighten cylinder head fixing bolts in sequence from (1) to (10) shown in illustration:

a. Apply a small amount of oil to bolt head and root.

b. Install bolts and tighten them in place by hands.

c. Tighten cylinder head fixing bolts in following procedures:

1st step: Tighten bolts to 25 ± 1.5 N·m in sequence from (1) to (10) shown in illustration.
2nd step: Tighten bolts to 45 ± 3 N·m in sequence from (1) to (10) shown in illustration.
3rd step: Rotate bolts clockwise by 60° ± 5° in tightening sequence.
4th step: Rotate bolts clockwise by 60° ± 5° again in tightening sequence.

![](images/3bd25a702802802b7face08cbb64bd7fcfcb94ded34f37e555c4c9fdb2c87c58.jpg)

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_cfa16475` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Check cylinder head fixing bolts before installation. If they are damaged, replace immediately. Be sure to tighten cylinder head bolts strictly according to operating procedures above, to achieve the technology standard for vehicle usage.

2. Other installation procedures are in the reverse order of removal.

### Removal
`chery_a13_en_8f5f9838` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:transmission | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Turn off all electrical equipment and the ignition switch. 2. Disconnect the negative battery cable. 3. Remove the transmission assembly (See page 17-20, 18-82). 4. Remove the clutch assembly (See page 19-17). 5. Using a special tool (flywheel holding tool (7)), lock flywheel and remove bolts in sequence from (1) to (6) shown in illustration, then remove flywheel (8).

![](images/14f0df302ecbca8bc8d37cd640e2e69d19d69867c7e1854e7a48e97805ca1944.jpg)

### 个 WARNING
`chery_a13_en_aea80514` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Pay special attention to safety during operation.
Do not remove all fixing bolts without any auxiliary measures.

### Inspection
`chery_a13_en_26e2c013` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Check if crankshaft position signal gear is distorted or deformed. If damaged, replace flywheel. Clean signal gear before installation.

2. Check if starter drive gear ring is worn. If excessively worn, replace flywheel.

3. Check flywheel clutch lining contact surface. If contact surface is damaged or excessively worn, replace flywheel with a new one.

4. Measure flywheel end surface runout with a dial indicator. If measured value exceeds the limit, replace flywheel with a new one.

Limit for end surface runout: 0.1 mm

![](images/6578f66f5d893880a485fe2abad765faad31747bafa85b4633abc12278320023.jpg)

### 个 WARNING
`chery_a13_en_c72d36be` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Never reuse flywheel fixing bolts after removal.
Make sure to apply seal gum to flywheel fixing bolts, before bolting on flywheel.

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_b79e7e27` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Six bolt holes on the flywheel have asymmetrical positions. There is a matchmark hole on flywheel. The mark hole is located right above when 1st cylinder of engine is at top dead center and flywheel fixing bolts are aligned with bolt holes of crankshaft.

Installation procedures are in the reverse order of removal, and pay attention to the following:

1. Align flywheel installation hole with crankshaft positioning journal and then lightly push flywheel onto the journal. DO not tap flywheel with a hammer.

2. Replace the flywheel fixing bolts with new ones and apply seal gum to the bolt threads.

3. Install flywheel (8), and then hold flywheel securely with flywheel holding tool (7), then tighten flywheel fixing bolts in sequence from (1) to (6) in 2 steps.

1st step: 30 ± 2 N·m
2nd step: 45 ± 5°.

![](images/38c5c95bb0be6935f06d3bbf3bbcc50b15462fdab7431a26beec0c7ef0ab38eb.jpg)

### Removal
`chery_a13_en_618aafd5` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:transmission | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Turn off all electrical equipment and the ignition switch.
2. Disconnect the negative battery cable.
3. Remove the transmission assembly (See page 17-20, 18-82).
4. Remove the clutch assembly (See page 19-17).
5. Remove the flywheel (See page 07-49).
6. Remove the crankshaft rear oil seal. a. Using a screwdriver with the tip wrapped with tape, remove crankshaft rear oil seal (1).

![](images/c64371560b6b2f33c4b89d9ed74896a169d6a5844711aa5bba877d6149df0ce6.jpg)

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_490ff408` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Be careful not to damage surrounding parts and oil seal retainer, when removing oil seal.
Be careful not to damage oil pan gasket, when removing rear oil seal bracket.

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_dfa1162c` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

4. Remove the engine left mounting cushion assembly.

a. Remove coupling bolt (arrow) between left mounting bracket and left mounting cushion assembly. (Tightening torque: 65 ± 5 N·m)

`chery_a13_en_49e2cf16` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

a. Using a ridge reamer or equivalent, remove all carbon deposit from top of cylinder.

b. Remove fixing bolts (arrow) and connecting rod bearing cap. (Tightening torque: 1st step: tighten to 20 ± 3 N·m; 2nd step: tighten to 33 ± 3 N·m)

### HINT:
`chery_a13_en_7aad89a5` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/619191b83f9145e36983e2308fa55971fb755aaff4270b969040da4cfff6328d.jpg)

Using 2 removed connecting rod bearing cap bolts, remove connecting rod bearing cap with connecting rod bearing lower shell assembly by shaking connecting rod bearing cap from side to side as shown in illustration.

c. Using a hammer handle (1), push piston connecting rod assembly (2) out of top of cylinder.

![](images/d10eec3f36ab26f51d0648e127c6946fe641bd7e85c05d7ded36fa6c22fc3f5d.jpg)

28.Remove the connecting rod bearing.

a. Remove the connecting rod bearing (arrow).

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_1356cd21` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Be careful not to scratch cylinder wall during operation.
Attach a label with corresponding number to each piston connecting rod assembly to prevent incorrect installation.

29.Remove the piston rings.

`chery_a13_en_02fd9d7c` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

b. Remove oil ring rail and expander by hands.

30.Remove the piston.

Piston pin is semi-floating, it cannot be removed during servicing, because it cannot be assembled with ordinary processing technology after removal, if abnormal noise is occurred by incorrect piston pin clearance, replace piston connecting rod assembly.

31.Remove the crankshaft.

a. Evenly loosen and remove 8 crankshaft main bearing cap fixing bolts and 2 studs in order shown in illustration. (Tightening torque: 90 -100 N·m)

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_9b35d73d` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Insert bolts into bearing caps in order. Slightly pull up bearing cap and apply force to front and rear sides of cylinder block to pull out it as shown in illustration. Be careful not to damage the contact surface between bearing cap and cylinder block.

c. Take out the crankshaft.

### Inspection
`chery_a13_en_5b2abb2e` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Check the cylinder block.

Clean engine block thoroughly and check all hole passages for leakage.
Check engine block and cylinder bore for cracks.
Check bottom surface of engine block for cracks.

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_66ee5612` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

DO NOT wash cylinder at high temperature; otherwise, cylinder liner will stick out beyond engine block.

2. Check the flatness of engine block upper surface.

a. Clean the engine block upper surface.

b. Using a precision straightedge and feeler gauge, measure flatness of engine block upper surface.

![](images/8de8af1df802d1fd5886ffbd27de6744cd871f8ddb0845ff8e37eabee474f9f0.jpg)

If cylinder head flatness exceeds standard value, adjust it. If cylinder head flatness exceeds the limit, replace the cylinder head.

Maximum allowable wear thickness of engine block is 0.15 mm. Maximum allowable wear thickness of cylinder block and cylinder head is 0.20 mm.

![](images/9d4f37d7372a62e0d2dfe17cecef40d9522fec689e073eb71b6bf2abd460fbe5.jpg)

3. Check the cylinder.

a. Standard diameter and maintenance dimension for cylinder bore. Cylinder diameter is divided into four groups according to tolerance of 0.04 mm under the normal production condition.

Cylinder group marks are stamped on small flat surface on rear part of intake manifold side of cylinder block (as shown in illustration), code marks with Arabic numerals from left to right in turn are "– 4 – 3 –2–1–" of cylinder bore group number.

![](images/ed8684aa6b719d77fda7076800b5b41dd335e6db2bdf0275ab9dd2f6ef03a149.jpg)

It is allowed to increase bore for renovation under special circumstances. Cylinder bore for production repair are divided into three groups according to tolerance of 0.03 mm. When one cylinder bore is renovated to repair size, the other three cylinder bores should be processed to production repair size.

![](images/7363ac9be6718e5c795d0ca4820f1c42c7d11bfb98a8d921f3ec6ce4817f13aa.jpg)

b. Check the cylindricity of cylinder.

Using a cylinder gauge, measure cylinder bore at positions A, B and C in thrust and axial directions.

![](images/2c528f318582bf35685a30c4d4d7ec1b92e231e6ca72c25112277c16c791fef6.jpg)

Cylindricity calculation method (for general measurement):

Cylindricity is half of difference between maximum and minimum values of 6 measured values (6 bore values measured at A, B and C). Cylindricity (maximum diameter minimum diameter)/2 If average value of bore values or cylindricity measured at positions A, B and C exceeds specified value, replace engine block.

![](images/4305ef7253751b74444f272ce7ada727382137426ee5dd6efe6038ddc840dae3.jpg)

4. Check the piston.

a. Using a scraper, remove carbon deposits on piston top.

![](images/78844a043cd865ff3c560c395b823d60ab31324e655b2eaf21a1551cc0cf5457.jpg)

b. Using a piston ring, remove carbon deposits from piston ring grooves.

![](images/8bb83252fa244a8de9d934f28f12a432822e7dd754d20a5428a7bfd21a9beb3f.jpg)

c. Using a brush and solvent, thoroughly clean the piston.

![](images/da9770907df5279d0950e09a81b8455d09905949016e17042ab710ffc448d6a8.jpg)

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_8bc38efc` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

DO NOT use a wire brush to clean.

d. Measure piston diameter with a micrometer at position, that is approximately 10 mm above piston skirt in vertical direction of piston pin hole.

![](images/b73cc80e1bf213557710ea29dddc1d4e30b54c875c403600048838afbad861ed.jpg)

![](images/80a53f414c7c5f502dd6309389872fe20f972edd3b21ddf989b4dcd71205dc2b.jpg)

If piston diameter is not within specified range, replace the piston connecting rod assembly.

5. Check clearance between piston ring and ring groove side.

Using a feeler gauge, measure clearance between new piston ring and ring groove side.

![](images/601451ecad4b0f48f95e55e3f925f0a697fba4ecdff9dda47655d3c19efd4539.jpg)

![](images/af941241bd0be3c01a11b68cb6e3dac79d71f911e1702ab5d2e77f27a560db4b.jpg)
If piston ring side clearance is not within specified range, replace the piston connecting rod assembly.

6. Check the piston ring end gap.

a. Using a piston, push piston ring from top of cylinder to a place, that is 45 mm from the top of cylinder bore. b. Using a feeler gauge, measure the end gap.

![](images/3ee6b0227fa9c2d07d1ee96340e25a4df01b94c6e626d7720c9a3f152961de8c.jpg)

RA13T071040

![](images/182cb06bbfd47b071b61b05c3c93e8d867b64fed4e21df4b4144106583d9e8d2.jpg)

If piston ring end gap is not within specified range, replace piston rings with a new set. If end gap is still not within specified range after replacement, replace the engine block.

7. Check the diameter of crankshaft main journal.

a. Measure main journal diameter with an outer diameter micrometer, and measure again after rotating the crankshaft 90°.

![](images/9ae8a611975f87f7c76d3036d1e8549b4603ee3587221a7a9180bd3ab87f8f50.jpg)

If crankshaft main journal diameter is not within specified range, replace main bearing shells with new ones and check radial clearance of crankshaft (See page 07-73).

If radial clearance of the main bearing shell is still not within specified range after replacement, replace the crankshaft.

![](images/a22ce29033813b21369b7d1fcb70e97b47c5e7b195ed76f8de032f38a3db3590.jpg)

b. Calculate roundness and cylindricity with measured values (measured area is shown in the illustration). Roundness and cylindricity calculation method (for general measurement):

Measure the diameter twice on the same cross section, and roundness is half of difference between maximum and minimum values.
Roundness = (maximum diameter minimum diameter)/2
As shown in illustration, measure diameter twice in different directions on two cross sections separately to obtain four values. Cylindricity is half of difference between maximum and minimum values among four values.
Cylindricity = (maximum diameter minimum diameter)/2

![](images/7279b1bf45b3481aa6b2861935788cfc75e0e502c1376bacd9cf385b3a4c0eb1.jpg)

If roundness or cylindricity of crankshaft main journal exceeds specified value, replace the crankshaft.

8. Check the crankshaft radial clearance.

a. Clean crankshaft main journals and main bearing shells.

b. Install the crankshaft. Place the plastic feeler gauge (1) on crankshaft main journal, parallel to crankshaft center axis and as wide as distance covered by bearing cap.

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_8cf0e5b4` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/cfbce2989e81271c176f8edb9adf95916fb08d4793c23267d430296238de43f0.jpg)

c. Install all main bearing caps and tighten main bearing cap fixing bolts to 90 \~ 100 N·m in order.

d. Remove the main bearing caps. Using a feeler gauge, measure widest part of compressed feeler gauge. Measured value is the crankshaft radial clearance.

![](images/ee7598546ff01560cffb5846868e6470c9b029452437414d8ef55de2679bfd56.jpg)

If crankshaft radial clearance exceeds specified range, install new main bearing shells. Replace the crankshaft if necessary.

![](images/9e1905a85c09ad18fc7f3ea8e44aa7995b94d0134f1b679149e96da35733556a.jpg)

CAUTION

Replace bearing shells in pairs.

For selection of main bearing shell (See page 07-73).

9. Check the crankshaft axial clearance.

a. Clean crankshaft main journals and main bearing shells.
b. Install all main bearing caps and tighten main bearing cap fixing bolts to 90 100 N·m in order.

c. Push crankshaft forward and backward and read value from dial indicator.

![](images/760f6efcffd3cb577547ba87cc09a62aed014a21d74ce0d87415f95869c1a9c9.jpg)

If crankshaft axial clearance is not within specified range, replace the thrust washers as a set.

10.Check the crankshaft runout.

a. Install crankshaft onto tester and keep it level as shown in illustration.
b. Rotate crankshaft slowly and read maximum change value from dial indicator. (Readings from dial indicator)/2 is the coaxiality of crankshaft.

![](images/c973b1d37a29ec0f571dac5d465e5ab39f0bd15386ce600221e14f40f4759008.jpg)

If crankshaft main journal runout is not within specified range, replace crankshaft.

11.Check diameter of crankshaft connecting rod journal.

![](images/853af20065d3c3afc94d1d3184f8f1face2d781de8b2f5e5bc9bd11ce598148c.jpg)

RA13T071090

Using an outer diameter micrometer, measure diameter of crankshaft connecting rod journal.

![](images/0bcb22ebcc2672a799d33360559b7e3c4462b6676a62bf042155200afcfe7d58.jpg)

![](images/13e4b22d290e30508072f3c5cc8862c9947a33e8bfc49030e363f322d7371671.jpg)

If connecting rod journal diameter is not within specified range, replace the connecting rod bearing shells with new ones, and check radial clearance of connecting rod bearing shell.

If radial clearance of connecting rod bearing shell is still not within specified range after replacement, replace the crankshaft.

For selection of connecting rod bearing shell (See page 07-73).

12.Check radial clearance of crankshaft connecting rod bearing shell.

a. Clean connecting rod journals and connecting rod bearing shells b. Place a feeler gauge (arrow) on connecting rod journal as shown in illustration.

![](images/f7ccde86fccd63df048bce9b4e44c2ddc1a2b1d74cc782a48c58469b22e0f297.jpg)

Chery Automobile Co., Ltd.

c. Install connecting rod bearing caps, and tighten connecting rod bearing cap fixing bolts to 20 + 5 N·m.

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_1ab909bd` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

DO NOT turn crankshaft during installation.

d. Remove the connecting rod bearing caps (See page 07-79).

e. Using gauge scale of feeler gauge, measure widest part of compressed feeler gauge to obtain radial clearance of connecting rod bearing shell as shown in illustration.

![](images/bf9145ae1c812d02822702177660de3add39f2f365ea15b0a48b856420cd0744.jpg)

If radial clearance of connecting rod bearing shell is not within specified range, replace the connecting rod bearing shells. Replace the crankshaft if necessary.

13.Check connecting rod big end axial clearance.

![](images/cc4a39d8b632f713ff7a839c196145803dafa7b83661cf40b668cac2f0ee1acc.jpg)

a. Install connecting rod bearing caps, and tighten connecting rod bearing cap fixing bolts to 20 + 5 N·m.

b. Install a dial indicator (2) with its plunger contacting the side of connecting rod cap (1). c. Turn the dial of dial indicator to reset it to zero. d. Push connecting rod forward and backward (do not move crankshaft forward and backward) and read value on dial indicator.

![](images/ac0c02269439212406d09a418570d81d8db47a3ab9137297bed1d1893f605cd2.jpg)

If axial clearance of connecting rod big end is not within specified range, replace the piston connecting rod assembly.

![](images/63a6f27be041d43e5f4527a76a670871e9feebf73d0fa21488cbd013ebbe5f83.jpg)

### Selection of bearing shell
`chery_a13_en_3efafcc4` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

SQRD4G15B engine uses main bearing shells and connecting rod bearing shells with "standard type" in production, there are no color codes on main bearing shell and connecting rod bearing shell, and just "STD" is printed on the back of bearing shell.

Main bearing shell has three kinds of bearing shell for maintenance, and connecting rod bearing shell has two kinds of bearing shell for maintenance during production repair.

1. Selection of main bearing shell

![](images/b771eccd07d1143e9268822e84e01b6c5a97a1a92a7c449cb3007cca72b27861.jpg)

2. Selection of connecting rod bearing shell

![](images/f8d3a9eab42cc454bf97cd8b8039e42101bbfd0c4386e169a04680b8dc127e7a.jpg)

3. Precautions for bearing shell assembly:

There are shell groove and oil hole on the main bearing upper shell, and oil hole should be aligned with that on the engine block, but the main bearing lower shell has no oil hole.
Connecting rod upper and lower bearing shells without oil grooves are universal, but one of the connecting rod bearing shells has an oil hole.
It is necessary to use a set of connecting rod bearing shell and main bearing shell that are provided by the same manufacturer on the same engine.
Apply a coat of engine oil to inner surface of connecting rod bearing shell and main bearing shell before installation. Back side of bearing shell should be clean without any oil or foreign matter during assembly.

### Assembly
`chery_a13_en_952ed79f` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Install the piston cooling nozzles.

a. Remove piston cooling nozzle fixing bolts (arrow), and remove piston cooling nozzles from cylinder block. (Tightening torque: 20 +5 N·m)

![](images/c9cbfa4c44362081863b433dfaed56a2e3ca3f933754cf73cbfd316d9ae16209.jpg)

2. Install the crankshaft main bearing shells.

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_a4c10248` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Apply a coat of engine oil to inner surface of the main bearing shell before installation.

a. Carefully install crankshaft bearing (1) in direction of arrow, and notch of each main bearing should be aligned with cylinder block. Oil passage hole on crankshaft main bearing (2) should be aligned with the passage hole on cylinder block after installation.

![](images/578981bdfdaa2f2e5b14b09428f3d84c882ca6e03523ac8bb418af827521c6e8.jpg)

3. Install the crankshaft thrust washers.

a. Clean crankshaft thrust washers and cylinder block inner wall before installation.
b. Apply a coat of engine oil to crankshaft thrust washers.
c. There are 2 crankshaft thrust washers on the cylinder, which are installed on the front and rear sides of thrust surface (both sides of 3rd bearing) respectively.

d. As shown in the illustration, the two grooves on one side of crankshaft thrust washers (1) face outward while the other side without groove is jointed with the cylinder block inside wall.

![](images/61f9fde163c649d0d6e7f5076a8a131261298e74d474758e070b6895451e8227.jpg)

4. Install the crankshaft.

a. Place crankshaft on cylinder block carefully.

b. "1-2-3-4-5" and "arrow" are marked on crankshaft main bearing cap. Install crankshaft main bearing cap from timing belt side and make sure that direction of "arrow" towards timing belt side.

c. Install crankshaft main bearing cap fixing bolts in place by hands, and then tighten crankshaft main bearing cap fixing bolts in sequence shown in illustration.

(Tightening torque: 90 - 100 N·m)

![](images/20e0b5b253991dd6781af336b6ce72e2e87fbdad05eae928439fd1e4ee2098cb.jpg)

5. Install the piston rings.

a. First compression ring is straight-flanked ring (1), second compression ring is conical ring (2), and oil ring is steel band combination oil ring. Apply a small amount of engine lubricant to piston ring grooves and piston. Note that the side with words for first compression ring should face upward, and outer cut of second compression ring should face downward.

b. Oil ring is steel band combination oil ring and composed of upper rail (3), lower rail (5) and expander (4). When installing the oil ring, first install the expander into oil groove, then install two rails with two rails opening of steel band combination oil ring staggered by 90° from the expander closed gap, and the upper and lower rails 180°. Then install the second compression ring, and install the first compression ring finally with two compression rings staggered by 120° from the upper rail opening. The piston ring should rotate in the ring groove freely without any stuck condition. The piston ring should rotate in the ring groove freely without any stuck condition.

c. Rotate the piston ring several turns after applying engine position of ring notch should be the same with that described above; clean the crankshaft connecting rod journal and cylinder bore with a non-woven fabric cloth.

6. Install the connecting rod bearing shells.

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_8f92852b` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Apply coat of engine oil to inner surface of connecting rod bearing shell before installation.

Back side of connecting rod bearing shell should be clean without any oil or foreign matter during assembly.

a. Carefully install the connecting rod bearing upper shell (1) in direction of arrow, and keep the groove opening of each connecting rod bearing upper shell face the piston and connecting rod assembly.

b. Carefully install the connecting rod bearing lower shell (1) in direction of arrow, and keep the groove opening of each connecting rod bearing lower shell face the connecting rod bearing cap.

![](images/9aa84609a5af9874dbcce82dd570adb54a1220f66c9e3458d37965069579aa45.jpg)

7. Install the piston connecting rod assembly.

a. Rotate the crankshaft to the top dead center of cylinders 1 and 4.
b. Apply a coat of engine oil to the piston surface and cylinder inside wall.

c. As shown in the illustration, install the piston connecting rod assembly to the cylinder with the piston installer (1).

![](images/b1ed1f79352e67ea739f7e9dafd0d24e89c633bc51e418fc0f724c8d9e6e4157.jpg)

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_5c5cf1ea` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Pay attention to front marks on piston and connecting rod during assembly, without being reversed. Face letter "F" side printed on connecting rod and arrow direction on piston toward pulley side to install as shown in illustration.

![](images/f91b2ee9120bc9c952022229549dec103948d631622e60f2804127e40d5c2940.jpg)

8. Install the connecting rod bearing cap.

### HINT:
`chery_a13_en_df144186` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Number on connecting rod and number on connecting rod bearing cap should be in the same direction. These numbers represent the number of cylinder, for example, figure 3 indicates that installation position is cylinder 3.

![](images/609e49d6faf833763448493781bf46577aac4180dfe4584d9c8bd52fd8f6cf7a.jpg)

a. Correctly install connecting rod bearing caps, and screw connecting rod bearing cap fixing bolts (arrow) by hands, then tighten connecting rod bearing cap fixing bolts to 20 + 5 N·m with a torque wrench.

![](images/443311a22d3d32d255dca369f756ef00c1a3cce3e005d964e328555606947181.jpg)

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_fabd4a72` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Apply a small amount of engine lubricant to connecting rods, connecting rod bearing caps and thread joint surfaces.

### Description
`chery_a13_en_e397df7f` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:fuel_ev | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/238e4d81855e7c33147959f6222a1a19d351f3cc4088efd0fe6239fe6fbd322a.jpg)

RA13T080010

![](images/94b25cb21abdc0077ed9a186ed8ec03bb44aaf4a0d8f95d41f29718f60dac95c.jpg)

![](images/4fc6e024bb49517817661a3a12670fc5bfd8964921cd1f112ffc135d41ebb0b2.jpg)

Engine fuel supply system provides a certain amount and concentration of combustible air-fuel mixture and supplies it to cylinders according to the requirements under various operating conditions of engine. Fuel supply system consists of fuel tank assembly, electric fuel pump assembly, fuel filter assembly, delivery pipes, fuel rail and injectors, which is used for fuel storage, filtration, delivery and injection. The function of fuel supply system is to provide gasoline with sufficient pressure to fuel injectors by using electric fuel pump assembly, and injector injects a certain amount of gasoline to top of intake valve in intake manifold in accordance with control signals from ECM.

### Fuel Supply System Line Connection Diagram
`chery_a13_en_636358ac` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:fuel_ev | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/da6381e05160f78c705e45df49b9b724833763db93c56464e09cac20c441f940.jpg)

![](images/5f77340ff1c41f2bb76cec19168ab5360e2be2773bc963bedb84c602b8d4d2d8.jpg)

When engine operates properly, electric fuel pump (1) sucks fuel from fuel tank and filters it through fuel filter (3), and then deliveries it to inlet and return pipe assembly (4). Part of fuel enters fuel rail (5) and is supplied to injectors. Part of fuel flows back to electric fuel pump assembly pressure regulator (2) directly. When fuel supply system pressure is high, diaphragm spring in regulator is jacked up by pressure, then the valve opens and fuel flows out from regulator. When pressure reaches normal value, regulator shuts off and fuel stops flowing out. Finally, system pressure reaches a steady state.

### Problem Symptoms Table
`chery_a13_en_a042f053` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Fuel Supply System Problem Symptoms Table

![](images/b76b04b377206ed84a5208818ea486d428da6831df708fc64df1c16671558b4f.jpg)

### 个 WARNING
`chery_a13_en_2891d838` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

When engine is not operating, fuel pressure in fuel supply system is still high. Before repairing or disconnecting fuel line or fuel supply system components, it is necessary to release fuel supply system pressure to prevent fuel from spraying out accidentally. Failure to follow these instructions may result in serious personal injury or death.

Perform following procedures to release fuel pressure in fuel supply system:

1. Recognize and remove electric fuel pump assembly relay from engine compartment relay box.

![](images/f479ddeac17fb5b6685788c37ebf54e3979cbcc88296f1573b9d0ba306c64971.jpg)

2. Start and run engine until it stalls.
3. Restart engine until it does not run.
4. Turn ignition switch to LOCK.
5. Disconnect the negative battery cable.
6. Insert electric fuel pump assembly relay into original position.

### Fuel Supply System Pressure Test
`chery_a13_en_08036cbb` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Fuel Pressure Specifications

![](images/f7958b4a9852ca4f7f8fa75c9c4eb9863653becc65493a57bbe0a992ec4ff45f.jpg)

### 个 WARNING
`chery_a13_en_69db6e6d` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

When operating fuel supply system, work area should be in good ventilation and keep fire sources or open flames away from work area, in which fire extinguisher should be equipped.

Before operating fuel supply system, please touch vehicle body to discharge static electricity; failure to do so will cause a fire, even result in an explosion.

Before removing and installing fuel pipes, release fuel supply system pressure.

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_7b5bb0a9` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:fuel_ev | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Make sure that battery voltage is 11 - 12 V.
Service mileages of fuel filter should be within 30000 km.
Make sure that fuel supply system lines are securely connected, preventing fuel supply system from leaking.

1. Release the fuel system pressure (See page 08-10).

2. Disconnect inlet hose connector and connect fuel supply system pressure tester between inlet hose and fuel rail.

![](images/b4eb6ae2872f8d210a46da8569a7e92d32bd972c2c60ed629ce10fa0e9a1b5a6.jpg)

3. Start engine and run it at idle, and then read value on pressure tester. Start engine and read value while idling:

Standard pressure at idle should be higher than 400 kPa.
If measured pressure value is lower than 400 kPa, check fuel filter for blockage.
Replace fuel filter if necessary (See page 08-12).
If measured pressure value is lower than 400 kPa and fuel filter operates properly, check electric fuel pump assembly. Replace as necessary.
If measured pressure value is too high, injector may be clogged or electric fuel pump assembly pressure modulating valve may be malfunctioning.
Replace injector (See page 08-22) or electric fuel pump assembly (See page 08-14) if necessary.

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_86ac036f` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

DO NOT damage disconnected fuel system line or connectors. Cover line joints or connectors with plastic bags or equivalent, preventing foreign matter from entering.

### A WARNING
`chery_a13_en_4088514e` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Before operating fuel supply system, please touch vehicle body to discharge static electricity; failure to do so will cause a fire, even result in an explosion.
When operating fuel supply system, work area should be in good ventilation and keep fire sources or open flames away from work area, in which fire extinguisher should be equipped.
After performing procedures for fuel system pressure release, there still remains some pressure in fuel line. When disconnecting fuel line, cover the joint with a piece of cloth or equivalent to prevent fuel from spraying out.
If fuel leakage occurs when operating fuel supply system, please handle leaked fuel in time.

Disconnection way for all fuel pipe coupling joints in following procedures is shown in illustration.

![](images/ee82258e2de7a2f9f42311995fd34eed1bbbe677ac3dc548ac35426b40fbc624.jpg)

1. Release the fuel supply system pressure (See page 08-10).

2. Turn off all electrical equipment and the ignition switch.

3. Disconnect the negative battery cable.

4. Remove the fuel filter assembly.

a. Disconnect coupling joints (arrow) on both ends of fuel filter.
b. Loosen the fuel filter bracket fixing screw (1). (Tightening torque: 5 ± 1 N·m)

![](images/66fd4d94bea3726c44e4a1e180e2175c412774ee369e5d2f8f2af9928912f273.jpg)

c. Remove fuel filter from fuel filter bracket.

Chery Automobile Co., Ltd.

`chery_a13_en_0df23d10` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Cover both ends of fuel filter with plastic bags or equivalent to prevent foreign matter from entering.

![](images/045adb7c800368e07e08f802d4aa3960440c4e280daccb0246a525b0b6ea28e0.jpg)

### ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION
`chery_a13_en_ec825ebf` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_93cdd2ef` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Before connecting hose, check if there is any damage or foreign matter on hose or joint. After installing pipe joint clip, check that fuel pipe joint cannot be pulled out. Be careful not to damage joint. clip is damaged, replace it. ### On-vehicle Inspection
`chery_a13_en_5d7c3049` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:fuel_ev | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

1. Inspect the electric fuel pump fuel level sensor.

a. Using a flat tip screwdriver, pry up electric fuel pump assembly protective cap, and disconnect electric fuel pump connector. b. Using a digital multimeter, measure resistance of fuel level sensor based on fuel volume in fuel tank.

![](images/68abaa19fdbde04fabf43f5b830f1686021c6047f1787278d61fc27781026a99.jpg)
If result is not as specified, replace electric fuel pump.

2. Check the electric fuel pump operation.

![](images/edb8acef0d2b8b03897a193814016ee54edadb103d680ac4d0b7aaf4062c25e1.jpg)

a. Using a flat tip screwdriver, pry up electric fuel pump assembly protective cap, and disconnect electric fuel pump connector.

b. Apply battery voltage to terminals 2 and 1. Check if electric fuel pump operates within 10 seconds.

HINT:

These tests must be finished within 10 seconds to prevent coils from being burnt.

Keep electric fuel pump as far away from battery as possible.

Always switch voltage on and off on battery side, rather than electric fuel pump side.

![](images/6ca505273199fafcf29edd5720faf6ff75e69e800d232b0193d0ad1f73086bbc.jpg)

If electric fuel pump does not operate, replace it.

![](images/619ad705dd1a50fbce407f49d1f3184c9685699c4cb649e6a3158be12d728282.jpg)

### 个 WARNING
`chery_a13_en_4088514e` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_4a437178` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:fuel_ev | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Only use parts approved by Chery Automobile Co., Ltd. to replace electric fuel pump assembly. As electric fuel pump assembly radiates through fuel, low fuel level in fuel tank will directly shorten the service life of electric fuel pump assembly.
Keep electric fuel pump assembly and work area clean when replacing electric fuel pump assembly; otherwise the electric fuel pump assembly element will be clogged.
DO NOT operate electric fuel pump assembly when it is dry or in water. Failure to do so will damage electric fuel pump.
DO NOT damage disconnected fuel system line or connectors. Cover line joints or connectors with plastic bags or equivalent, preventing foreign matter from entering.
Keep fuel tank and line clean, and replace fuel filter if electric fuel pump assembly has been replaced.

![](images/cacb40df2b87143c8e516922ca29afad6d11aa97621509bcf84ff39e2bf74b37.jpg)

1. Release the fuel system pressure (See page 08-10).
2. Turn off all electrical equipment and the ignition switch.
3. Disconnect the negative battery cable.
4. Open fuel filler cap and discharge fuel vapor in fuel tank.
5. Remove the rear seat cushion (See page 47-15).

6. Remove the electric fuel pump assembly.

a. Using a flat tip screwdriver (1), pry up electric fuel pump assembly protective cap (2).

![](images/f91e7aee9e258d9ef7df19521e506731a8286186a83eee08f6e0506a91fc17b7.jpg)

b. Disconnect the electric fuel pump assembly connector (arrow).
c. Disconnect coupling joint (1) between electric fuel pump assembly and inlet pipe assembly.
d. Disconnect coupling joint (2) between electric fuel pump assembly and return pipe assembly.

![](images/584175c77b1a7835ff6446a15393c1e4baf6d4efa8483fd8759b6d3129f8b3c0.jpg)

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_83cd4a4e` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:fuel_ev | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Before disconnecting joints, remove all dirt and foreign matter from electric fuel pump assembly pressure cap.

DO NOT forcefully bend or twist delivery pipes.

e. As shown in illustration, use special tool (fuel tank pressure cap remover) to remove fuel tank pressure cap. (Tightening torque: 75 ± 5 N·m)

![](images/d9ad04a5e88393bd614ef20e2fbe82b2c5758d95ab18ca1cb9f341c5dbbd1540.jpg)

f. Pull electric fuel pump assembly upward and pull out fuel tank.

![](images/40b1ba56bdc28551ee57b958c5d210227fadcbcc9b5d904414bdfd62dd762b64.jpg)

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_93d8bd3c` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:fuel_ev | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

To keep fuel tank clean, cover it completely with a plastic bag or equivalent to prevent foreign matter from entering.
Electric fuel pump can be put into a container and taken out of cabin, thus preventing fuel in pump from dropping into cabin.

1. Fuel Vapor Valve

Function of fuel vapor valve:

When fuel vapor is produced in fuel tank, fuel vapor will enter charcoal canister through fuel vapor hose (1) by fuel vapor valve (2). When vehicle body bumps or overturns, fuel vapor valve will automatically lock to prevent fuel overflow.

When filling fuel tank through fuel filler, fuel vapor will get out of fuel tank through fuel breather pipe (3).

### Description
`chery_a13_en_1f981c2f` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:fuel_ev | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/15faa300529f7b79653f16a68591743236dd24bd0cc7646de15dec2463517521.jpg)

RA13T090010

![](images/460c9991ec58734f4a080ae689a3ffb3a1e0f5250371ee9be34026e113e07e14.jpg)

Emission control system recovers and burns fuel vapor to prevent the vapor in fuel tank from being discharged into the atmosphere. It monitors the oxygen content in exhaust gas, so as to guarantee the maximum efficiency of catalytic converter assembly in converting the HC, CO and NOx in exhaust gas.

Activated charcoal canister plays an important role in emission control system. it is used to absorb and filter moisture and fuel vapor. Fresh air enters bottom of activated charcoal canister while fuel vapor enters top of activated charcoal canister through pipe. When engine stops operating, fuel vapor and fresh air will be stored in activated charcoal canister. When canister solenoid valve opens, fuel vapor will enter intake manifold to burn.

Oxygen sensor consists of upstream oxygen sensor and downstream oxygen sensor. Upstream oxygen sensor is installed on exhaust manifold, and downstream oxygen sensor is installed on main catalytic converter assembly. Oxygen sensor can detect oxygen content in exhaust gas, and determine whether combustible air-fuel mixture is completely burnt out or not, so as to guarantee the maximum efficiency of catalytic converter assembly in converting the HC, CO and NOx in exhaust gas.

### Description
`chery_a13_en_cba24e20` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/eab3c0585a85367af32816f5fa604f553bf55ad72f1e00817bc5ba9ee566d194.jpg)

RA13T100010

![](images/2df0a7f18dd35bd7fcd1fe914399615ec5dde5db5e5986f4051639804cab7d99.jpg)

Intake system mainly consists of air direct pipe, air filter assembly, intake pressure/temperature sensor, intake hose, electronic throttle assembly and intake manifold assembly, etc.

Intake system uses air filter to filter particulates and dust in air, and then the air filtered flows into intake manifold assembly through electronic throttle assembly and mixes with fuel at the end of intake manifold assembly port to form flammable gas mixture, which is transmitted to each cylinder uniformly to coordinate with engine operation. Electronic throttle assembly is a critical part for engine intake system. Its main function is to control intake air volume by adjusting intake passage area according to driver's driving intention to meet intake requirements in different engine operating conditions, and send back position signals of throttle valve plate to control unit to achieve accurate control and run the engine under optimal control state.

The temperature of engine compartment is very high when engine is running. Before removal, you must make sure that engine has shut off, and engine compartment has cooled down sufficiently, otherwise, there is a risk of scald injury.

Try to prevent body paint surface from being scratched during removal and installation.

2. Disconnect the negative battery cable.

3. Remove the engine trim cover.

a. Loosen worm clamp (arrow) between intake hose and electronic throttle assembly. (Tightening torque: 2.5 ± 0.5 N·m)

b. Disconnect intake hose and electronic throttle assembly, and move intake hose to one side.

5. Remove the electronic throttle assembly.

a. Disengage the wire harness clip (arrow). b. Disconnect the electronic throttle assembly connector (1).

![](images/986a1c958d98238824f725e7c9e0c86db9822283b7ea8e2ccaf36dae76e2949d.jpg)

c. Remove 4 fixing bolts (arrow) from electronic throttle assembly. (Tightening torque: 8 - 11 N·m)

Remove electronic throttle assembly, and face valve plate upward in free condition. Avoid cleaner flowing into electronic element through valve plate shaft, resulting in functional failure.

### CAUTION
`chery_a13_en_1778cb07` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

The temperature of exhaust system is very high when engine is running. Before removal, you must make sure that engine has shut off, and exhaust system has cooled down sufficiently, otherwise, there is a risk of scald injury. Be sure to wear necessary safety equipment to prevent accidents when repairing. Try to prevent body paint surface from being scratched during removal and installation.

1. Release the fuel system pressure (See page 08-10).

2. Turn off all electrical equipment and the ignition switch.

3. Disconnect the negative battery cable.

4. Remove the engine trim cover.

5. Remove the fuel rail injector assembly (See page 08-22).

7. Remove the intake manifold assembly.

a. Disconnect intake pressure/temperature sensor connector (1), loosen and remove fixing bolt (arrow), then remove intake pressure/temperature sensor. (Tightening torque: 8 ± 1 N·m)
b. Loosen elastic clamp (1), and disconnect PCV hose and intake manifold.
c. Loosen elastic clamp (3), and disconnect vacuum booster hose and intake manifold.
d. Disconnect charcoal canister solenoid valve connector (4), and move away charcoal canister solenoid valve from bracket.
e. Disconnect oil pressure switch connector (1) and wire harness clip.
f. Remove 2 fixing bolts (arrow) from booster pipe. (Tightening torque: 25± 3 N·m)

![](images/3d9728d630a25493d607d9a501d16a61799b7d265234f280ed0e0b6260a406b7.jpg)

h. Move away engine wire harness bracket, remove engine right lifting eye and intake manifold assembly. 8. Disassemble the intake manifold.

a. Remove fixing bolt (1) from charcoal canister solenoid valve bracket, and remove charcoal canister solenoid valve bracket. (Tightening torque: 20 +5 N·m)
b. Remove fixing bolt (2) from intake manifold upper bracket, and remove intake manifold upper bracket. (Tightening torque: 20 +5 N·m)
c. Remove gasket (arrow) from intake manifold.

### Description
`chery_a13_en_0306b322` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

![](images/dc7fb25801c6631d25e0757836452314733f44b0501acb4cdeca71e2ac14fc50.jpg)

![](images/ca6939afe34b6f87c4e1bf3e20fa8469f19f4b72f3b48be718b2f4bc28889729.jpg)

Exhaust system is used to control engine exhaust, reducing vehicle emissions by precatalytic converter and main catalytic converter, and eliminating exhaust noise by muffler.

When exhaust system discharges gas, oxygen sensor monitors oxygen content in exhaust gas. Engine control module adjusts air-fuel ratio of combustible gas mixture to control vehicle emissions and achieve optimal fuel economy according to feedback signals of oxygen sensor and combining with other sensor signals.

### Exhaust System Gas Leakage Inspection
`chery_a13_en_805d0e97` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:engine | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

Inspection method for gas leakage in exhaust system joints:

Warm up engine for a while, and check exhaust system joints for gas leakage. A certain amount of gas leakage at exhaust pipe joint is allowed, but gas leakage at joint between exhaust manifold and cylinder head is prohibited. Judging standard is that there is no shuddering in engine and no "poof" sound is heard from joints.

### A WARNING
`chery_a13_en_341c0a46` | a13 | pdf_manual | tier:4 | lang:en | layer:general | p:1 | doc_type:service_manual

2. Disconnect the negative battery cable.
